task: Adversarial review fix (Security Auditor): bound compute_peaks_sidecar's decode memory/CPU, found during the audio_player_completion_004 plan's adversarial review

app/engines/audio_ops.py.summary: Added PEAKS_MAX_DECODE_SAMPLES = 20_000_000. compute_peaks_sidecar now asks ffmpeg to downsample (-ar) when the probed duration_sec * sample_rate would exceed that many decoded samples, bounding the in-memory raw-bytes + array.array buffers and the per-sample Python max-abs loop regardless of source WAV length. Short/typical files decode at native rate, unaffected. Previously only the OUTPUT bucket count (PEAKS_MAX) was capped; the INPUT decode size was unbounded, a real memory/CPU DoS-caliber gap for a long WAV inside a synchronous request handler.

flow_impact: none — same public contract (compute_peaks_sidecar(wav_path) -> dict | None); only the internal decode strategy for very long inputs changed.
